verdict.rationale: Navan documents several natural-language interfaces. Navan Edge lets users book, change, and cancel flights, hotels, and restaurants by chatting, with explicit confirmation before acting. Ava answers T&E spend questions conversationally, and the hosted Navan MCP server lets Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, and others query spend, travel, and policy data in natural language. Missing for 10: evidence that MCP or Ava can take write actions (e.g., submitting or approving expenses, issuing reimbursements) rather than just answering queries; Edge being limited to the most frequent travelers; any independent or hands-on corroboration.
